CustomField.description: Displays image of active, suspended or inactive depending on status
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(Round__c = null, Collection_Suspended__c = False), IMAGE("/resource/CollectionSchedule/CollectionStatus/Pending.jpg","Pending"), IF(Week_Off__c, IMAGE("/resource/CollectionSchedule/CollectionStatus/WeekOff.jpg","Week Off"), IF( Collection_Suspended__c = true, IMAGE("/resource/CollectionSchedule/CollectionStatus/Suspended.jpg","Suspended"), IF(End_Date__c < TODAY(), IMAGE("/resource/CollectionSchedule/CollectionStatus/Expired.jpg","Expired"), IMAGE("/resource/CollectionSchedule/CollectionStatus/Active.jpg","Active")))))
CustomField.label: Collection Status
